jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Android
jobs.description: Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next-gen aerospace sector building an end-to-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems (“UAS”), aviation-related physical artificial intelligence (“AI”) solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors. Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members. Archer is best known for Midnight, our electric aircraft. This role isn t on that program. The AI Products Org builds consumer software for the general aviation industry. There s a lot we re not ready to talk about publicly yet, so this posting stays vague on purpose. What we can say: the products are real, they ship, and people use them every day. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other. About the Role As a Senior AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
tags: inl - institut des nanotechnologies de lyon
jobs.description: Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit. The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible. The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability. jobs.title: Senior Multiphysics R&D Engineer (Electro-mechanical)
jobs.description: With over 140 years of Swiss engineering heritage, Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in high-power electrical and electronic equipment. Our solutions power railways, renewable energy, DC and AC networks, and industrial systems worldwide trusted for their precision, reliability, and innovation. At the heart of modern rail infrastructure, our Traction Power Systems unit delivers cutting-edge DC and AC traction substations, protection systems, power conversion and digital monitoring solutions. Join us to shape the future of sustainable mobility with technology that keeps cities and countries moving. For the expansion of our team, we are seeking to hire in Geneva a dynamic and motivated Senior R&D Engineer. As a Senior Multiphysics R&D Engineer, you will be involved with the R&D team in the development of cutting-edge high-speed switching devices such as high-speed DC circuit breakers, contributing to the full product lifecycle: from design to application. You will work at the intersection of electrical and mechanical engineering, bringing expertise in power electronics, dielectrics and thermal advanced modeling, playing a key role in shaping the future of medium voltage switching technology. Main Responsibilities: Contribute to innovative R&D projects focused on high-speed circuit breakers and related switching technologies. Design and simulate electrical switching systems using MATLAB/Simulink, COMSOL MultiPhysics including electromagnetic, thermal, material science and dielectric behavior. Define and execute test plans for prototypes, including dielectric, thermal, and mechanical validation. Interface with cross-functional teams including mechanical, electrical and electronics engineers. Collaborate with manufacturing teams to optimize material processing and industrialization. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical strategy and innovation roadmaps. Contribute to patent filings, technical documentation, and compliance with IEC/IEEE standards. Deve

Nous changeons la donne en construisant la plateforme d'investissement tout-en-un, propulsée par l'IA : suivre ses actifs, gérer son budget, investir et se former, au même endroit. jobs.title: Account Executive - AI Native, EMEA
jobs.description: About Us: AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp , Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn , Luigi ), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. The Role: We’re hiring an Account Executive to win and grow Modal’s relationships with AI-native companies: the startups and scale-ups building their products on models from day one. These teams move fast, so our sales cycle does too. Deals often move forward from the very first call, and you’ll usually be talking directly with the founder or technical leader who owns the budget. You’ll own the full cycle, from sourcing to close to expansion, and you’ll partner closely with our founders, engineering, and product teams. You’ll also help build Modal’s presence in the developer community, because in this market, the best pipeline comes from engineers who already love the product. The ideal candidate has an engineering background, has worked as a solutions architect or in a similar technical role, and has since moved into selling. You’re as comfortable debugging a cold-start issue with an ML engineer as you are

jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics. What is your Day to Day Mission: Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers. Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators. System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses. Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs. jobs.description: Who We Are At RelationalAI , we’re solving one of the most important challenges in artificial intelligence: how to teach large language models the logic, semantics, and business context of the modern enterprise. Frontier models are trained almost entirely on public data — they can speak about the world, but they don’t understand your business. We fix that. RelationalAI has pioneered a breakthrough called Superalignment — technology that enables LLMs to learn natively from private, structured enterprise data inside the data cloud. By combining this with relational knowledge graphs and our proprietary neuro/symbolic-relational reasoners , we deliver trustworthy decision intelligence : systems that use semantic models to truly understand how a business operates and can reason across its data to drive better outcomes. We’re a globally distributed team of engineers, scientists, and builders redefining how AI learns from data. We believe that high-stakes decisions deserve frontier intelligence — intelligence that’s explainable, aligned, and grounded in reality. If you’re driven by curiosity, thrive in complexity, and want to help build the system that brings true understanding to enterprise AI, you’ll feel right at home here. Then you'll model their world in our ontology, formulate the reasoning problem, write the PyRel, and ship something that runs against their real data in their own Snowflake account. jobs.title: Manager, Quantum Applications Software
jobs.description: PsiQuantum s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.   Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.   Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.   That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum s most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel s Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico s Niklas

jobs.description: About CodeRabbit CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship. We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. jobs.title: Internship
jobs.description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. The Role This is a 4-month program: 3 months in Berlin, 1 month in New York. You’ll join one of our tracks (CEO Office, Growth, Product, Ops or Talent) and own real work from day one. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects. Recent projects run by interns: Rebuilt our talent engine and cut time-to-fill from 82 days to 34. Took a new product from first customer call to production launch. Relaunched our CRM to drive data accuracy. Built the sales case behind our largest deals. jobs.description: At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning Axle’s commercial results in the Dutch market: pipeline, revenue and partner success Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. Werkzeuge, Schnittparameter und Spannstrategien für Aluminium, Stähle, Titan und Inconel auswählen. Toolpath-Bibliotheken, Programmiervorlagen und Dokumentation von Grund auf aufbauen. Wir verbinden moderne Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und unsere eigene Software MasonOS, um Präzisionsteile für Unternehmen aus Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie und Zukunftstechnologien zu fertigen, mit Fabriken in Großbritannien, den USA, Deutschland und Frankreich. Unsere Mission: industrielle Beschleunigung schmieden. Die Rolle Steuere den Betrieb in Hamburg: von der Bestellung bis zur Auslieferung. Termin, Durchsatz, Material. Heute zwei Maschinen, im April sieben. Dazu Partnerfabriken der Gilde und Lieferanten, die uns nicht gehören. Du entscheidest, welcher Auftrag auf welcher Maschine liegt, was nach draußen geht und was wir zusagen. Zerspanung, Engineering und Qualität sind eigene Teams auf Augenhöhe. Du führst sie nicht, du arbeitest mit ihnen. Dein Bereich ist Fertigungssteuerung, Wareneingang und Warenausgang, und du berichtest an den Head of Operations. Passend für jemanden, der einen Plan lieber verantwortet als kommentiert. Was du verantwortest Liefertreue und Durchsatz: Reihenfolge und Belegung über alle Maschinen, geplant in MasonOS. Liefertermine setzen und halten, auch bei Schnellanfragen: Angebot in 12 Stunden, Lieferung in 3 Wochen. Wareneingang, Warenausgang und Materialfluss, von Stangen und Rohteilen bis zum versendeten Teil. Arbeit an Partnerfabriken der Gilde und qualifizierte Lieferanten routen und sie auf unserem Standard halten. Taktzeiten, Auslastung, Ausschuss und Liefertreue: wöchentlich berichtet und abgestellt, nicht gesammelt. Was du mitbringst Operative Führung in der Produktion: hohes Tempo, lange Durchlaufzeiten, kleine Lose. Termin- und Kapazitätsplanung selbst gemacht, nicht delegiert. Lieferanten und Unterauftragnehmer gesteuert, inklusive Eskalation. Du denkst in Systemen: Kapazität, Restriktionen, Reihenfolge, Durchsatz. Deutsch und Englisch sicher: Die Halle läuft auf Deutsch, die Gruppe auf Englisch. Schön wäre Zerspa

jobs.description: Über Isembard Isembard baut ein Netzwerk hochleistungsfähiger Fabriken für kritische Industrien auf. Wir verbinden moderne Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und unsere eigene Software MasonOS, um Präzisionsteile für Unternehmen aus Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie und Zukunftstechnologien zu fertigen, mit Fabriken in Großbritannien, den USA, Deutschland und Frankreich. Unsere Mission: industrielle Beschleunigung schmieden. Die Rolle Die Teile, die du fertigst, landen in Flugzeugen, Verteidigungssystemen, Energieinfrastruktur und Robotern. Eine Hands-on-Rolle in unserer Hamburger Fabrik: Du verantwortest deine Arbeit vom Programm bis zum fertigen Teil, statt sie weiterzureichen. Die Fabrik ist noch im Aufbau. Du gestaltest das Setup mit, statt darauf zu warten. Deine Aufgaben CNC-Toolpaths programmieren, simulieren und optimieren (3-Achs, 5-Achs und Fräs-Drehen, wo es passt). Jobs nach Luft- und Raumfahrt- und Verteidigungsstandards einrichten, einfahren und produzieren. Zykluszeiten und Maschinenauslastung verantworten. Vorrichtungen, Werkzeuge und Schnittparameter für Aluminium, Stähle, Titan und Inconel auswählen. Neuteile von der Zeichnung bis zur stabilen Serie bringen, mit DFM-Feedback an den Kunden. Was du mitbringst Fundierte CAM-Programmierung in Fusion, Hypermill, Mastercam oder vergleichbar. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Toleranzen von ±0,01 mm oder enger. Erfahrung im Einrichten und Fahren von High-End-Maschinen wie Hermle, DMG Mori oder Mazak. Tiefes Verständnis von Vorschüben, Schnittgeschwindigkeiten, Werkzeugstrategie und Spanntechnik. Sicheres Lesen komplexer Zeichnungen und GD&T. Schön wäre Erfahrung in Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung oder anderen High-Spec-Branchen. Simultane 5-Achs-Bearbeitung. Messtaster, Automatisierung oder Palettensysteme. EN 9100, AS9100 oder ISO 9001. Etwas Englisch, für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Teams in Großbritannien und den USA. Warum Isembard Sicherheitskritische Bauteile für Luft- und Raumfahrt und Verteidigung

jobs.title: CAM Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Isembard Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration. The role Own CAM programming and machining standards at our Hamburg factory, from toolpath to first article prove-out, cycle time optimisation and production handover. You will build the programming playbook our German sites run on. You program it, you prove it out, you run it. What you'll do Program, simulate and optimise 3-axis and 5-axis milling toolpaths. Set up, prove out and run jobs to aerospace and defence standards. Choose tooling, cutting parameters and workholding for aluminium, steels, titanium and Inconel. Build toolpath libraries, programming templates and documentation from scratch. Train machinists on programming standards as the team grows. What we're looking for Strong CAM programming in Hypermill, Mastercam, Siemens NX or equivalent. A record of holding tolerances of ±0.01 mm or tighter. Experience setting and running high-end machines such as Hermle or DMG Mori: you can program and run the machine yourself. A solid understanding of feeds, speeds, tooling strategy and workholding. Confident reading of complex drawings and GD&T, with clean documentation and revision control. Nice to have Aerospace or defence manufacturing. 5-axis simultaneous machining. Titanium, Inconel and high-strength alloys. NC simulation such as Vericut. EN 9100 or AS9100. Why Isembard Technical authority over programming standards across our German sites. Work on mission-critical aerospace and defence components. Advanced 5-axis machine tools and growing automation. Competitive salary and equity. Location: On-site at our Hamburg factory. jobs.title: CMM Programmer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Isembard Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration. The role Own dimensional inspection at our Hamburg factory, from CMM programming and first article inspection to non-conformance root cause and audit readiness. You will build the metrology function rather than inherit one: inspection programmes, probing and datum strategy, gauge calibration, and how quality data flows back into machining and MasonOS. You program it, you measure it, you sign it off. What you'll do Program and optimise CMM inspection routines in PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso or equivalent for complex, tight-tolerance parts. Run first article inspection (EN 9102), in-process inspection and final sign-off for aerospace, defence and energy work. Set probing strategy, fixturing and datum schemes, and build inspection fixtures where needed. Find the root cause of non-conformances and take the corrective action back to the machine with our machinists and CAM programmers. Own calibration of all measuring equipment and keep records to EN 9100 standard, ready for customer and certification audits. What we're looking for Several years of hands-on CMM programming in precision manufacturing, aerospace or a machine shop. Strong practical command of PC-DMIS and/or Zeiss Calypso. Deep working knowledge of GD&T and ISO GPS, and confident with customer 3D CAD models. Aerospace inspection documentation: FAI, AS9102 or EN 9102. Able to measure and verify tolerances of ±0.01 mm and tighter. Nice to have Building a quality function from scratch, or taking a site through EN 9100 or AS9100. GD&T certification or a quality management qualification. In-process probing on 5-axis machines with closed-loop correction.

jobs.description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution The Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Engineer at Black Semiconductor to lead the mechanical design, upgrading, and installation of facility plants and mechanical systems. The role covers critical facility infrastructure, including chillers and heat pumps, compressors, Make-up Air Handling Units (MAHUs), HVAC systems, exhaust systems, water distribution systems, and steam generators. You will coordinate engineering companies, vendors, and suppliers to ensure the successful execution of mechanical engineering activities and contribute to the continuous improvement of facility plants and systems. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
